programme.title: Lion Country: Night and Day
programme.desc: This documentary series follows two lion prides that share overlapping territory in South Luangwa National Park, Zambia. Over the course of six months, filming 24 hours per day, a specialist camera team tracks two separate lion families while encamped deep in the bush. A close, but somewhat dangerous, proximity to the prides allows the crew to capture the most intimate and dramatic moments of these big cats' lives. Classed as `vulnerable' by the International Union for Conservation of Nature, the world lion population is down by 40 per cent over the last 20 years, making the cubs invaluable to the future of the species.

programme.title: Secret Agent
programme.desc: Forced to live a detached life in the Andaman Islands, a secret agent comes across a woman pursued by debtors and tries to protect her.

programme.title: Prince No. 1
programme.desc: Raja falls in love with Rani but breaks off the relationship due to family pressure. Later, when he has all but given up hope of seeing her again, he gets a surprise.

programme.title: Udumba
programme.desc: An orphan lives a carefree life as he spends time with his lady-love and friends. However, his world comes crashing down after he learns the truth about his past.

programme.title: Coolie Raja
programme.desc: When a woman from a wealthy family falls in love with a porter, the couple tries to prove that their love is stronger than the differences in their social status.

programme.title: Weapon The Hathyar
programme.desc: Despite suffering from a rare medical disorder, a young athlete strives for sporting glory. However, his efforts are threatened after he gets entangled in a sinister counterfeiting operation.

programme.title: Haunted Mahal
programme.desc: When mysterious deaths plague a haunted bungalow, a young man begins to investigate. However, his research leads him to uncover the mansion's dark past and ghostly secrets.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: A young man falls in with the wrong crowd and strays from heroic deeds. However, an accidental encounter with danger forces him to change his ways.

programme.title: DD Returns
programme.desc: An event manager and his friends hide the money they stole in a haunted bungalow to evade the police but when they go back to retrieve it, the ghosts force them to play a dangerous game.

programme.title: MCA: Middle Class Abbayi
programme.desc: Nani, a middle-class boy with an eidetic memory, helps save his sister-in-law from a goon. Meanwhile, he also tries to convince his girlfriend's father to marry her off to him.

programme.title: Surya Ka Yaarana
programme.desc: Surya, a soldier going on a rescue mission, hears about his father's death from lung cancer and mournfully looks back on his memories of how he helped him in matters of love and life.

programme.title: Hanu Man
programme.desc: A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.

programme.title: Siren
programme.desc: After serving 14 years in prison, a man is released on parole. As he tries to reconnect with his family, he vows revenge against those who wronged him.
